ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 60
   D. 30

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

5. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 11
   D. 12

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

11. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 50

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

13. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 30

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

17. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

18. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 19
   D. 23

20. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 72

21. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
